'''Dirk Kreimer''' (born 12 July 1960) is a [[Germans|German]] [[physicist]] who pioneered the [[Hopf algebra|Hopf-algebraic]] approach to [[Feynman diagram|perturbative]] [[quantum field theory]] with [[Alain Connes]] and other co-authors. He is currently [[Alexander von Humboldt Professor|Humboldt professor]] at the department of mathematics of [[Humboldt University]] in [[Berlin]], where he teaches the courses of ''Quantum Field Theory'' (I and II) and ''Hopf Algebras and the Renormalization Group''.<ref>{{Cite web |title=40515 Renormalization, Hopf algebras and the renormalization group |url=http://www2.mathematik.hu-berlin.de/~kreimer/teaching/introrge/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160526084130/http://www2.mathematik.hu-berlin.de/~kreimer/teaching/introrge/ |archive-date=2016-05-26 |accessdate=12 January 2022 |website=Group of Prof. Dr. Dirk Kreimer}}</ref>
